sources.clearance: Author archived appendix describes epsilon as the minimum admissible distance but gives no value. The fixed 1 mm value is a declared local development policy.
sources.collocation: Archived author arXiv TeX commented appendix: k/Nc for k=1,...,Nc-1; 149 bindings. Published text says Nc points, so exact implementation is unresolved.
sources.endpoint_copies: Reconstruction choice: one extra copy at each endpoint of the cubic warm start, making its endpoint velocities zero while retaining all DRM nodes.
sources.engineering: Iteration limit 2000, solver tolerances, initialization duration length+2, positive duration bounds, and 60-second budget are explicit local protocol choices, not published exact settings.
sources.iteration_limits: Local policy: SNOPT total 100000 / major 2000 / minor 500; IPOPT max_iter 2000. All construction, solves and refinement checks share the external online deadline.
sources.published: RSS 2025 Werner et al., VII-A.3 and Appendix D; 4th order time spline, SNOPT distance, IPOPT time, Nc=150
sources.refinement: Local constraint generation: after each native solve, add the minimum-clearance sampled parameter in each current interval with clearance below 0.5 mm. At most 4 solves and 600 total points. No control insertion or case-specific policy.
